basic_info.description: Large light-filled mid-Richmond 3 bedroom 2 bath condominium on 2 levels, 1736 square feet and built in 1999 per tax record. This is the upper unit of a 2 unit condo building. The main floor consists of a large living room/dining area with wood floors and fireplace, 2 bedroom and 1 bath, in unit laundry, hookups only, and a large rear deck with Trex decking.  Upper level is vacant and consists of a large room with skylight and bath with tub and separate stall shower. This top floor level has both front and rear Trex decks. One car parking in a side by side garage and extra storage space in garage.  Only 3 blocks to Golden Gate Park and 1 1/2 blocks to Geary Blvd transit, restaurants and shops.
